tasks.title: book Hanoi accommodation for 10th and 11th of Oct
tasks.scratchpad: i need to find two a airbnb or nice accom with two different bedrooms because my friend is staying too
suggestions: Stay in the Old Quarter (Hoan Kiem) for these 2 nights. Cat Ba Express and most limousine operators include free hotel pickup ONLY inside the Old Quarter — staying elsewhere (e.g. Tay Ho) means getting yourself to their office at 214 Tran Quang Khai St for the 12 Oct transfer.

Filter trap to avoid: on Airbnb set 'Entire place' + Bedrooms = 2, NOT '2 beds' — plenty of Hanoi listings advertise 2 beds in a single room, which fails your two-separate-bedrooms requirement. Same on Booking.com: a 'Family Suite' is often one room with two beds; filter Property type = Apartments instead.

For only 2 nights, Old Quarter serviced aparthotels often beat Airbnb: two real bedrooms, daily cleaning, 24h reception, and — important for you — free luggage storage while you're over on Cat Ba 12–17 Oct, so you don't drag everything to the island.
Book something refundable. You're heading to Cat Ba for climbing on the 12th and October can bring storms up there; a flexible rate on the Hanoi bookends costs little and saves rebooking pain.

When you book, confirm the exact pickup address with the transfer operator and aim for the 07:30 departure on 12 Oct (other slots: 10:30, 12:00, 14:00) — it gets you climbing that afternoon. Check the hotel does early breakfast or at least has 24h reception.

You also have 'Book cat ba accom for 12th to 17th' and 'Book Cat Ba accommodation 18th–20th' open — if the 18–20 stay is a return leg, ask the Hanoi place to hold your bags across the whole Cat Ba stretch rather than booking storage separately.
